# Jacob Orbach

> Freelance full-stack developer based in Tel Aviv. Builds web products end to
> end — custom WordPress and Gutenberg, React/Node/TypeScript applications, API
> and webhook integrations, payment systems, and AI features — and grows them
> organically from zero traffic.

Jacob is unusual in combining two skill sets that are normally split between two
hires: shipping production software, and earning the organic search traffic that
makes it findable. He has taken his own products from launch to live paying
customers (GhostChat, Gmailytics, KaspaWoo), and separately built and grown six
web properties from zero organic traffic — the same work he does for clients.

Available for freelance and contract work, and open to full-time engineering
roles. Works with clients globally from Israel; native English speaker.

## Hire him

- [Work with me](https://jacoborbach.com/services/): what he builds, the proof behind it, engagement models, and process. Small, clearly scoped jobs are fixed-price and delivered in about a week, half paid upfront, starting at $500; custom payment gateways start at $1,200. Ongoing WordPress care plans (updates with a backup first, monitoring, fix time) are $250/mo for up to 3 hours a month, or ₪500/mo + VAT for up to 2.5 hours in Israel; sites that are badly out of date get a one-time catch-up quote first. Details: [WordPress care](https://jacoborbach.com/care/). **Larger builds and development retainers are quoted after a written scope.**

Typical fixed-price jobs: a WordPress plugin or block-first Gutenberg build; an
AI assistant or LLM feature wired to your own content; a third-party API or
webhook integration; a Stripe or WooCommerce payment fix; a performance rescue;
a migration.

## Services

- [WordPress care / maintenance](https://jacoborbach.com/care/): monthly WordPress upkeep by a developer who builds WordPress: core, plugin and theme updates with a backup before every change and staging tests where the host supports it, uptime and security monitoring, a short monthly report, and monthly fix time. $250/mo (3 hrs) or ₪500/mo + VAT (2.5 hrs) in Israel. Response within one business day; cancel with a month's notice. Hebrew section on the page.

- [Custom AI integration](https://jacoborbach.com/services/ai-integration/): LLM-powered support agents, retrieval-grounded answers, cost-controlled per-message model routing, prompt-injection-aware architecture. Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and self-hosted Ollama. Publishes the open-source `ghostchat-agent` runner on npm and runs a Claude-based responder in production.
- [Payment integrations](https://jacoborbach.com/services/payment-integrations/): Stripe subscription billing, Meshulam SDK, custom WooCommerce payment gateways, non-custodial cryptocurrency payments, invoicing and reconciliation. Built a system processing $1M+/year (annualized).
- Custom WordPress and Gutenberg: plugins, block-first builds, custom themes, WooCommerce, WPML multilingual with Hebrew RTL. Shipped 30+ custom React-based Gutenberg blocks for enterprise clients plus an ACF block generator that cut block development time by roughly 80%. Maintains two plugins published on WordPress.org, one a WooCommerce payment gateway.
- Web applications and integrations: React, Next.js, Node, TypeScript, PHP. Third-party APIs, OAuth, webhooks, CRM syncs, Chrome extensions, real-time features, and database migrations run without downtime.
- SEO and organic growth: technical SEO, rendering and indexability, keyword architecture, internal link engineering, and scalable page templates — diagnosed and implemented by the same person.

## Proof

- [Portfolio and work history](https://jacoborbach.com/): shipped products, professional roles, testimonials, and technical stack.
- Migrated a 100,000+ record CRM to Salesforce with zero data loss and zero downtime; cut support response time from hours to under 10 minutes with LiveChat bots and Salesforce webhooks.
- Built an end-to-end Strapi payment system on the Meshulam SDK processing $1M+/year (annualized) in transaction volume.

## Products built

- [GhostChat](https://ghostchat.dev/): privacy-first chat widget, ~15KB vanilla-JS SDK, 3-8x faster than legacy tools. Next.js dashboard on Vercel, Cloudflare Workers API with Durable Objects for real-time messaging, Supabase, Stripe.
- [Gmailytics](https://gmailytics.com/): Google CASA Tier 2 certified Gmail cleanup SaaS. 5M+ emails cleaned, 300GB storage freed.
- [KaspaWoo](https://kaspawoo.com/): open-source Kaspa cryptocurrency payment gateway for WooCommerce, built on his MIT-licensed `kaspa-simple-wallet` npm package.
